records.jp: こ、これって……
records.en_original: Th-that's...
records.en: Th-that's...

records.jp: ら、ライム……っ！！
records.en_original: L-Lime...!!
records.en: L-Lime...!!

records.jp: さっき、この雫世界は私たちが作ったと話したと思う
records.en_original: Remember? I said that Lime and I created the Oasis.
records.en: Remember? I said that Lime and I created the Oasis.

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: 正確には、あなたたちリフレクターの力を借りて<CR>私とライムが維持・管理をしている
records.en_original: More exactly, Lime and I borrowed your Reflector powers to support and manage it.
records.en: More exactly, Lime and I borrowed your Reflector powers to support and manage it.

records.jp: わたしたちの……？
records.en_original: Our powers?
records.en: Our powers?

records.jp: リフレクターの力は、すなわち想いの力。<CR>何かを想う強い感情のエネルギーが、力になる
records.en_original: The power of a Reflector is the power of emotions. The stronger the emotion, the stronger their power.
records.en: The power of a Reflector is the power of emotions. The stronger the emotion, the stronger their power.

records.jp: そして……得てしてそれは、<CR>リフレクターが持つ大切な思い出に結びついている
records.en_original: Usually the strongest emotion a Reflector has is related to their most treasured memory.
records.en: Usually the strongest emotion a Reflector has is related to their most treasured memory.

records.jp: なるほど、「“大切な思い出”を借りる」……<CR>だから記憶がなくなってるのか
records.en_original: And borrowing our memories caused us to forget them...
records.en: And borrowing our memories caused us to forget them...

records.jp: そういうこと
records.en_original: Exactly.
records.en: Exactly.

records.jp: ライムは、その想いの力を管理して<CR>世界を維持するため、意識の大部分を使っている
records.en_original: It takes almost all of Lime's consciousness to use the power of those memories to support this world.
records.en: It takes almost all of Lime's consciousness to use the power of those memories to support this world.

records.jp: その結果として……休眠状態にある
records.en_original: Because of that she's now...dormant.
records.en: Because of that she's now...dormant.

records.jp: そ、そんな……
records.en_original: No...
records.en: No...

records.jp: ライムは、死んじゃってるわけじゃないんだよね……？
records.en_original: She's not...dead, right?
records.en: She's not...dead, right?

records.jp: うん、安心して。死んではいない
records.en_original: Don't worry. She's still alive.
records.en: Don't worry. She's still alive.

records.jp: ただ、雫世界を維持し続ける必要がある限り、<CR>目覚めることもできない……
records.en_original: But as long as she sustains the Oasis, she won't be waking up.
records.en: But as long as she sustains the Oasis, she won't be waking up.

records.jp: なら一刻も早く、<CR>外の世界で生きる方法を見つけないと……！！
records.en_original: Then we have to find a way to return safely to the other world as soon as possible!
records.en: Then we have to find a way to return safely to the other world as soon as possible!

records.jp: でもそんな方法、どうすれば……
records.en_original: But how can we possibly...
records.en: But how can we possibly...

records.jp: 世界が危機に陥った真実を解き明かして、<CR>安全な場所を見つけ出すしかない
records.en_original: Our only option is to discover the truth behind the state of the world, and find somewhere safe.
records.en: Our only option is to discover the truth behind the state of the world, and find somewhere safe.

records.jp: 真実を……
records.en_original: Discover...
records.en: Discover...

records.jp: 解き明かす……
records.en_original: The truth...
records.en: The truth...

records.jp: この世界には、まだ合流できていない<CR>リフレクターがいる
records.en_original: There are still Reflectors we've yet to meet in this world.
records.en: There are still Reflectors we've yet to meet in this world.

records.jp: ついさっきまで、ずっと寝てるのか起きてるのか<CR>分からないような状態だったから……
records.en_original: Up until now I wasn't sure if I was awake or dreaming...
records.en: Up until now I wasn't sure if I was awake or dreaming...

records.jp: そういえば、わたしもそうでした。<CR>突然意識がはっきりして、そしたら皆さんがいて……
records.en_original: Now that you mention it, that's how I felt too. I suddenly snapped awake, and all of you were there.
records.en: Now that you mention it, that's how I felt too. I suddenly snapped awake, and all of you were there.

records.jp: そのリフレクターを全員<CR>ここに集めて、記憶を取り戻す
records.en_original: We have to find all the Reflectors and return their memories.
records.en: We have to find all the Reflectors and return their memories.

records.jp: そして、みんなが持ってる断片的な記憶を集めて、<CR>元の世界で何が起きたのかを明らかにする
records.en_original: Then, we gather all your fragmented memories, and find the answers to our questions.
records.en: Then, we gather all your fragmented memories, and find the answers to our questions.

records.jp: なぜ灰が降ったのか
records.en_original: Why is the Ash falling?
records.en: Why is the Ash falling?

records.jp: クラックから出てきた敵は何なのか
records.en_original: Why did enemies come through the Crack?
records.en: Why did enemies come through the Crack?

records.jp: 元の世界は今、どうなっているのか……<CR>それを知らないことには、何も始まらない
records.en_original: What is the world like now? We won't get anywhere without these answers.
records.en: What is the world like now? We won't get anywhere without these answers.

records.jp: 原因が分からないと、解決のしようがないもんね……
records.en_original: Can't find a solution without knowing the cause...
records.en: Can't find a solution without knowing the cause...

records.jp: でも、どうやって集めればいいの？
records.en_original: But how're we supposed to find them?
records.en: But how're we supposed to find them?

records.jp: 春日さんや白井さんがどうしてここに来たのか、<CR>いまだによく分かってないのに……
records.en_original: We still don't even know how or why Kasuga and Shirai appeared...
records.en: We still don't even know how or why Kasuga and Shirai appeared...

records.jp: 想いが重なる物を用意して
records.en_original: Find things that they have emotional attachments to.
records.en: Find things that they have emotional attachments to.

records.jp: みんなが学校に集まるのは、みんな学校に強い<CR>想いがあるから
records.en_original: You are all gathered at a school because you all have a strong emotional attachment to school.
records.en: You are all gathered at a school because you all have a strong emotional attachment to school.

records.jp: その学校に、残されたリフレクターと想いが重なる物を<CR>用意して、さらに“つながり”を強めればいい
records.en_original: So finding or creating things that the remaining Reflectors have emotional attachments to will make that connection even stronger.
records.en: So finding or creating things that the remaining Reflectors have emotional attachments to will make that connection even stronger.

records.jp: 秘密基地やカフェが、<CR>その“つながり”ってやつだったのかな
records.en_original: Like the secret hideout and the cafe?
records.en: Like the secret hideout and the cafe?

records.jp: じゃあ、今後もいろんなものを作ればいいんだ！
records.en_original: Well then, I guess all we have to do is build lots of different stuff!
records.en: Well then, I guess all we have to do is build lots of different stuff!

records.jp: まあ、言ってしまえばそういうこと
records.en_original: Essentially, yes.
records.en: Essentially, yes.

records.jp: そんな簡単な話じゃないと思うけどなぁ……
records.en_original: I have the feeling that it's a bit more complicated than that...
records.en: I have the feeling that it's a bit more complicated than that...

records.jp: 当然、いろいろ疑問も残ってると思う。<CR>私もすべては説明しきれていない
records.en_original: I'm sure you still have plenty of questions. I still haven't finished explaining everything I know.
records.en: I'm sure you still have plenty of questions. I still haven't finished explaining everything I know.

records.jp: それに……さっきも言ったけど、<CR>石橋を叩いて渡るだけの余裕は、もうない
records.en_original: But... As I said before, we can no longer afford to be cautious.
records.en: But... As I said before, we can no longer afford to be cautious.

records.jp: だからこれからは、私も協力できることは協力する。<CR>分からないことがあったら聞いて
records.en_original: I'll do what I can to help you. If there's anything you want to ask, just tell me.
records.en: I'll do what I can to help you. If there's anything you want to ask, just tell me.

records.jp: あ、じゃあフリスペ教えてよ
records.en_original: Cool. Give me your FreeSpace.
records.en: Cool. Give me your FreeSpace.

records.jp: えっ
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 連絡取れたほうが便利ですもんね
records.en_original: It's quite convenient for staying in touch.
records.en: It's quite convenient for staying in touch.

records.jp: そ、それはそうだけど……
records.en_original: I-I suppose so...
records.en: I-I suppose so...

records.jp: ほら！
records.en_original: Come on!
records.en: Come on!

records.jp: 司城夕月さんがグループに参加しました
records.en_original: Yuzuki Shijou joined the group.
records.en: Yuzuki Shijou joined the group.

records.jp: よろしく……
records.en_original: Hello...
records.en: Hello...

records.jp: よろ～！！
records.en_original: heya!!!
records.en: heya!!!

records.jp: よろしく
records.en_original: Greetings.
records.en: Greetings.

records.jp: よろしくお願いします！
records.en_original: Welcome to the group!
records.en: Welcome to the group!

records.jp: 一緒にライムちゃん、助けようね！
records.en_original: Let's all do our best to save Lime!
records.en: Let's all do our best to save Lime!

records.jp: ユズ、改めてよろしくね！
records.en_original: Glad to have you, Yuzu!
records.en: Glad to have you, Yuzu!

records.jp: そういえば、なんでユズちゃんは<CR>グループに入ってないんだろう？
records.en_original: I wonder why Yuzu wasn't in the group to begin with?
records.en: I wonder why Yuzu wasn't in the group to begin with?

records.jp: リフナビはこの世界に来た人はみんな入るって<CR>言ってたけど
records.en_original: Right... ReSource did say that everyone who comes to this world is added automatically.
records.en: Right... ReSource did say that everyone who comes to this world is added automatically.

records.jp: まあ、そういうこともあるんじゃ？<CR>こうして追加すればいいから問題なし！
records.en_original: Eh, I bet it's just a fluke. We were able to add her, so no big deal!
records.en: Eh, I bet it's just a fluke. We were able to add her, so no big deal!

records.jp: それもそっか
records.en_original: True...
records.en: True...

records.jp: 今後のこと考えないといけないし、<CR>一旦学校に戻ろっか
records.en_original: Let's head back to the school, huh? We should probably talk about what we're gonna do now.
records.en: Let's head back to the school, huh? We should probably talk about what we're gonna do now.
